provenance.source: Synthetic gene expression on the bundled participant, arm, visit and annotated-cell sampling structure.
provenance.aggregation: Gene values are cell means. All annotated cells is a cell-count-weighted mean over CD8 T cells, B cells and CD4 T cells.
provenance.sets: Hand-selected example gene sets. Each set score is the arithmetic mean of its three simulated gene values. These scores describe the expression of the listed genes.
provenance.fdrFamily: Benjamini–Hochberg adjustment across six simulated genes and two illustrative sets for each contrast and population.
provenance.fit: sctrial participant-level score models on participant-visit population means, with standardize=False.
